# ghost/survival-manual

Survival Manual (F-Droid): an offline survival guide with about 30 chapters (water, fire, shelter, first aid, knots ...). Read a chapter, scroll through it. No account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/survival-manual
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/survival-manual open_manual --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/survival-manual list_chapters --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/survival-manual open_chapter --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/survival-manual read_page --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/survival-manual scroll_page --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_manual`: Open the Survival Manual app
- `list_chapters`: What chapters does the survival manual have?
- `open_chapter`: Open the Fire chapter of the survival manual
- `read_page`: What does the survival manual page say now?
- `scroll_page`: Scroll down the survival manual page
